items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: Pop had, I don't know, I think Jeanette was working with him. She was working with Pops. ... Ben Ateno, he played with Pops too.

ctx.x: And use his name on the other thing? Yeah.
Most of the fellas used to do that. I never know if Sam would do anything like that, but most of the other fellas. Neither Pop is still a Stan.
Would people think you were Chris?
